## R Markdown


Load libraries and data
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(brms)
library(tidybayes)

data<-read.delim2("../Data/contact_time_r.txt")

```

Prepare the data

```{r}
data_ct <- data %>% 
  filter(SLS == "yes") %>%
  mutate(
    species = recode(Species,
                     "Desmo"    = "D. dianthus",
                     "Lophelia" = "D. pertusum"),
    contact_time = factor(contact_time,
                          levels = c("30sec","1min","5min","10min","30min","60min")),
    log_conc = log10(concentration + 1)
  )

dat_dd <- data_ct %>% filter(species == "D. dianthus")
dat_dp <- data_ct %>% filter(species == "D. pertusum") %>%
  droplevels() 
```

Bayesian model for D. dianthus 

```{r}
library(brms)

# priors for models WITH random effects (D. dianthus)
priors_ct <- c(
  prior(student_t(3, 0, 2.5), class = "Intercept"),
  prior(normal(0, 2), class = "b"),
  prior(exponential(2), class = "sd")
)


fit_dd <- brm(
  eggs_fertilised | trials(eggs_found) ~ 
        poly(log_conc, 2, raw = TRUE) * contact_time +
        (1 | Experiment),
  data   = dat_dd,
  family = binomial(),
  prior  = priors_ct,
  chains = 4, iter = 4000, cores = 4,
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95)
)

```

D. pertusum (only one cross)
Weakly informative priors for fixed effects
model
```{r}
# priors for models WITHOUT random effects (D. pertusum)
priors_ct_nore <- c(
  prior(student_t(3, 0, 2.5), class = "Intercept"),
  prior(normal(0, 2), class = "b")
)

fit_dp <- brm(
  eggs_fertilised | trials(eggs_found) ~ 
        poly(log_conc, 2, raw = TRUE) * contact_time,
  data   = dat_dp,
  family = binomial(),
  prior  = priors_ct_nore,
  chains = 4, iter = 4000, cores = 4,
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95)
)
```

checking both models

```{r}
## ---- Diagnostics for D. dianthus ----

# numeric summary (includes R-hat and n_eff)
summary(fit_dd)

# quick overall checks
max_rhat_dd  <- max(rhat(fit_dd))
min_neff_dd  <- min(neff_ratio(fit_dd))

max_rhat_dd
min_neff_dd

# trace plots for fixed effects
plot(fit_dd)   # brms default: trace + density for a few parameters

# posterior predictive check (more samples for a better feel)
pp_check(fit_dd, ndraws = 100)


## ---- Diagnostics for D. pertusum ----

summary(fit_dp)

max_rhat_dp  <- max(rhat(fit_dp))
min_neff_dp  <- min(neff_ratio(fit_dp))

max_rhat_dp
min_neff_dp

plot(fit_dp)
pp_check(fit_dp, ndraws = 100)


#how well does it fit?
bayes_R2(fit_dd)
bayes_R2(fit_dp)
```


predictions for plotting

```{r}
library(tidybayes)
library(tidyr)

make_grid <- function(dat) {
  dat %>%
    group_by(contact_time) %>%
    summarize(
      conc_min = min(concentration),
      conc_max = max(concentration),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      concentration = list(seq(conc_min, conc_max, length.out = 100))
    ) %>%
    tidyr::unnest(concentration) %>%
    mutate(
      log_conc   = log10(concentration + 1),
      eggs_found = 1          # <— key line
    )
}




grid_dd <- make_grid(dat_dd) %>% mutate(species = "D. dianthus")
grid_dp <- make_grid(dat_dp) %>% mutate(species = "D. pertusum")




```


```{r}
library(tidybayes)
```

```{r}
# Use only contact_time levels that the D. pertusum model actually saw
allowed_ct_dp <- levels(fit_dp$data$contact_time)

grid_dp_pred <- grid_dp %>%
  dplyr::filter(contact_time %in% allowed_ct_dp) %>%
  droplevels()

```


curves

```{r}
curves_dd <- grid_dd %>% 
  add_epred_draws(fit_dd, re_formula = NA) %>%
  mutate(p_fert = .epred)   # PROPORTION fertilised among eggs found

curves_dp <- grid_dp_pred %>% 
  add_epred_draws(fit_dp) %>%
  mutate(p_fert = .epred)

curves_all <- dplyr::bind_rows(curves_dd, curves_dp)
```


plot

no legend
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(viridisLite)
library(patchwork)

# full set of contact-time levels for plotting (we want empty panels)
all_ct_levels <- c("30sec","1min","5min","10min","30min","60min")

# split raw data by species
raw_dd <- data_ct %>%
  dplyr::filter(species == "D. dianthus") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    fert_prop    = eggs_fertilised / eggs_found,
    contact_time = factor(contact_time, levels = all_ct_levels)
  )

raw_dp <- data_ct %>%
  dplyr::filter(species == "D. pertusum") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    fert_prop    = eggs_fertilised / eggs_found,
    contact_time = factor(contact_time, levels = all_ct_levels)
  )

# curves per species, but with full level set for plotting
curves_dd_plot <- curves_dd %>%
  dplyr::mutate(contact_time = factor(contact_time, levels = all_ct_levels))

curves_dp_plot <- curves_dp %>%
  dplyr::mutate(contact_time = factor(contact_time, levels = all_ct_levels))

# colour palette for contact times
contact_time_colors <- setNames(
  viridis(length(all_ct_levels), option = "D", direction = -1),
  all_ct_levels
)

# pretty x-axis label with mL^-1
x_lab <- expression(paste("Sperm concentration (cells mL"^{-1}, ")"))

# ---------------------
# Plot for D. dianthus
# ---------------------
p_dd <- ggplot(
  curves_dd_plot,
  aes(x = concentration,
      y = p_fert,
      colour = contact_time,
      fill   = contact_time)
) +
  #stat_lineribbon(.width = c(0.66, 0.95), alpha = 0.4) +
  stat_lineribbon(.width = 0.95, alpha=0.4)+
  geom_point(
    data = raw_dd,
    aes(x = concentration, y = fert_prop, colour = contact_time),
    size = 1.6,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = contact_time_colors,
                      drop   = FALSE,
                      guide  = "none") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = contact_time_colors,
                    drop   = FALSE,
                    guide  = "none") +
  scale_y_continuous(
    "Fertilisation (%)",
    limits = c(0, 1),
    breaks  = seq(0, 1, by = 0.25),
    labels  = scales::label_percent(accuracy = 1)
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    NULL,
    limits = c(0, 5000),
    breaks = c(0,1000,2000,3000,4000,5000),
    labels = c("0","1K","2K","3K","4K","5K")
    #labels = scales::label_number(scale = 1e-3, suffix = "K")
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ contact_time, nrow = 1, drop = FALSE) +
  ggtitle("D. dianthus") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
    panel.spacing = unit(0.5,"lines"),
    strip.text.x    = element_text(size = 9),
    plot.title      = element_text(face = "italic", hjust = 0),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

# --------------------
# Plot for D. pertusum
# --------------------
p_dp <- ggplot(
  curves_dp_plot,
  aes(x = concentration,
      y = p_fert,
      colour = contact_time,
      fill   = contact_time)
) +
  #stat_lineribbon(.width = c(0.66, 0.95), alpha = 0.4) +
  stat_lineribbon(.width = 0.95, alpha=0.4)+
  geom_point(
    data = raw_dp,
    aes(x = concentration, y = fert_prop, colour = contact_time),
    size = 1.6,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = contact_time_colors,
                      drop   = FALSE,
                      guide  = "none") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = contact_time_colors,
                    drop   = FALSE,
                    guide  = "none") +
  scale_y_continuous(
    "Fertilisation (%)",
    limits = c(0, 1),
    breaks  = seq(0, 1, by = 0.25),
    labels  = scales::label_percent(accuracy = 1)
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    x_lab,
    limits = c(0, 6e5),
    breaks = c(0, 2e5, 4e5, 6e5),
    labels = c("0", "200K", "400K", "600K")
    #labels = scales::label_number(scale = 1e-3, suffix = "K")
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ contact_time, nrow = 1, drop = FALSE) +
  ggtitle("D. pertusum") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
    panel.spacing = unit(0.5,"lines"),
    strip.text.x    = element_text(size = 9),
    plot.title      = element_text(face = "italic", hjust = 0),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

# --------------------
# Combine the two rows
# --------------------


contact_final_plot <- (p_dd / p_dp) +
  plot_layout(heights = c(1, 1)) +
  #plot_annotation(tag_levels = "a") &
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "a", tag_prefix = "(", tag_suffix = ")") &
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.tag = element_text(
      #face = "bold",
      size = 12,
      hjust = 0, vjust = 1
    )
  )

contact_final_plot
```

list of colonies used

```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

data_raw<-data
names(data_raw)

class(data_raw)
head(data_raw$date_experiment)


data_tagged <- data_raw %>%
  filter(SLS == "yes") %>%
  mutate(
    species = recode(Species,
                     "Desmo"    = "D. dianthus",
                     "Lophelia" = "D. pertusum"),
    date_parsed = as.Date(as.character(date_experiment), format = "%Y-%m-%d"),
    year = as.integer(format(date_parsed, "%Y"))
  )

colonies_used_contact_time <- data_tagged %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(male, female),
    names_to = "sex",
    values_to = "colony_id"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(colony_id), colony_id != "") %>%
  distinct(species, year, sex, colony_id) %>%
  mutate(label = "Used for contact time") %>%
  arrange(species, year, sex, colony_id)

colonies_used_contact_time

```
export

```{r}
write.table(
  colonies_used_contact_time,
  file = "colonies_used_contact_time.txt",
  sep = "\t",
  row.names = FALSE,
  quote = FALSE
)

```
